cup.name: Ceramic Cup
cup.description: A small bowl-shaped container for drinking hot or cold beverages.
cup.safety_warning: Caution: May be hot if containing hot liquids. Handle with care.

laptop.name: Laptop Computer
laptop.description: A portable personal computer with an integrated screen and keyboard.
laptop.safety_warning: Keep away from liquids. Do not block ventilation vents to prevent overheating.

cell phone.name: Smartphone
cell phone.description: A portable communication and computing device with a touchscreen interface.
cell phone.safety_warning: Do not leave charging overnight. Avoid exposure to extreme heat.

bottle.name: Bottle
bottle.description: A container used to store water, beverages, or liquids.
bottle.safety_warning: Check for BPA-free label. Do not reuse single-use plastic bottles.

wine glass.name: Wine Glass
wine glass.description: A stemmed glass designed for drinking wine and other beverages.
wine glass.safety_warning: Fragile — handle with care. Wash gently to avoid breakage.

fork.name: Fork
fork.description: A utensil with prongs used for eating and serving food.
fork.safety_warning: Sharp prongs — keep away from young children.

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: A sharp bladed utensil used for cutting and preparing food.
knife.safety_warning: Extremely sharp — always cut away from the body. Store in a knife block or drawer guard. Keep away from children.

spoon.name: Spoon
spoon.description: A utensil with a shallow bowl-shaped head used for eating and serving.

bowl.name: Bowl
bowl.description: A round, deep dish used for serving food, soup, or cereals.
bowl.safety_warning: Check if microwave-safe before heating food in it.

microwave.name: Microwave Oven
microwave.description: An electric oven that heats food using microwave radiation for quick cooking.
microwave.safety_warning: Never use metal containers inside. Do not operate empty. Keep interior clean to prevent fire hazards.

oven.name: Oven
oven.description: A thermally insulated chamber used for baking, roasting, and heating food.
oven.safety_warning: Surfaces become extremely hot during use. Use oven mitts. Never leave unattended while in use.

toaster.name: Toaster
toaster.description: A small electric appliance used to brown and crisp bread slices.
toaster.safety_warning: Never insert metallic objects. Clean crumb tray regularly to prevent fire. Unplug when not in use.

sink.name: Kitchen Sink
sink.description: A fixed basin with a water supply and drain, used for washing dishes and hands.
sink.safety_warning: Ensure water temperature is regulated to avoid scalding. Keep drain clear of blockages.

refrigerator.name: Refrigerator
refrigerator.description: A large cooling appliance used to preserve food and beverages at low temperatures.
refrigerator.safety_warning: Keep door seals clean. Do not store hot food directly inside. Maintain 37-40°F (3-4°C) for food safety.

chair.name: Chair
chair.description: A piece of furniture designed for a single person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

couch.name: Sofa / Couch
couch.description: A large upholstered seat designed for multiple people to sit on comfortably.

bed.name: Bed
bed.description: A piece of furniture used for sleeping and resting, typically with a mattress and frame.

dining table.name: Dining Table
dining table.description: A flat-surfaced table used for dining, working, and other household activities.

toilet.name: Toilet
toilet.description: A plumbing fixture used for disposing of human waste, connected to a sewage or septic system.
toilet.safety_warning: Keep lid closed. Use non-slip mats on bathroom floor to prevent falls.

tv.name: Television
tv.description: An electronic display device used for watching broadcast content, streaming, and gaming.
tv.safety_warning: Keep children at a safe viewing distance. Secure large TVs to prevent tipping.

remote.name: TV Remote Control
remote.description: A handheld device used to wirelessly control a television or other media devices.
remote.safety_warning: Remove batteries if not used for extended periods to prevent leakage.

keyboard.name: Computer Keyboard
keyboard.description: An input device with keys used to type text and commands into a computer.

mouse.name: Computer Mouse
mouse.description: A handheld pointing device used to interact with a computer's graphical interface.

book.name: Book
book.description: A bound set of printed pages containing text or images, used for reading and reference.

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: A device used to measure and display the current time.

vase.name: Vase
vase.description: A decorative container, typically made of glass or ceramic, used to display flowers.
vase.safety_warning: Fragile — handle with care. Do not place where it can be easily knocked over.

potted plant.name: Potted Plant
potted plant.description: A plant grown in a container indoors for decorative or air-purifying purposes.
potted plant.safety_warning: Some houseplants are toxic to pets and children. Verify the species before purchase.

scissors.name: Scissors
scissors.description: A cutting tool consisting of two sharp blades joined at a pivot point.
scissors.safety_warning: Sharp blades — always pass handle-first. Keep away from children.

teddy bear.name: Teddy Bear
teddy bear.description: A soft stuffed toy in the shape of a bear, commonly given to children.
teddy bear.safety_warning: Check for loose parts (eyes, buttons) that could be a choking hazard for toddlers.

hair drier.name: Hair Dryer
hair drier.description: An electric device that blows hot or warm air to dry and style hair.
hair drier.safety_warning: Never use near water or in a bathtub. Unplug after every use. Keep cord away from heat.

toothbrush.name: Toothbrush
toothbrush.description: A small brush used with toothpaste to clean teeth and gums.
toothbrush.safety_warning: Replace every 3 months or after illness. Do not share toothbrushes.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: A bag carried on the back using two shoulder straps, used for carrying belongings.

handbag.name: Handbag
handbag.description: A small bag carried by hand or over the shoulder, used to carry personal items.

suitcase.name: Suitcase
suitcase.description: A large rectangular bag with a handle and wheels, used for travel and storing clothes.

umbrella.name: Umbrella
umbrella.description: A folding canopy supported by a handle, used for protection against rain or sunlight.

banana.name: Banana
banana.description: A long curved yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh, rich in potassium and vitamins.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: A round fruit with red, yellow, or green skin, known for its crisp texture and sweet flavour.

orange.name: Orange
orange.description: A citrus fruit with a bright orange peel, rich in vitamin C.

broccoli.name: Broccoli
broccoli.description: A green cruciferous vegetable with a tree-like structure, rich in fibre and vitamins.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.description: A root vegetable, typically orange, known for its high beta-carotene content.

pizza.name: Pizza
pizza.description: A flatbread dish topped with tomato sauce, cheese, and various toppings, then baked.

sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.description: A dish made of fillings such as meat, cheese, or vegetables placed between slices of bread.

hot dog.name: Hot Dog
hot dog.description: A cooked sausage served in a sliced bun, often garnished with condiments.

donut.name: Donut
donut.description: A sweet fried dough confection, usually ring-shaped and glazed or filled.

cake.name: Cake
cake.description: A sweet baked dessert made from flour, sugar, and eggs, often decorated with icing.

person.name: Person
person.description: A human being detected in the scene.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.description: A human-powered two-wheeled vehicle propelled by pedalling.
bicycle.safety_warning: Always wear a helmet. Use lights and reflectors when cycling at night.

car.name: Car
car.description: A road vehicle powered by an engine, designed to carry passengers.
car.safety_warning: Always wear a seatbelt. Do not use a mobile phone while driving.

motorcycle.name: Motorcycle
motorcycle.description: A two-wheeled motor vehicle, faster and more powerful than a bicycle.
motorcycle.safety_warning: Wear a full-face helmet and protective gear at all times.

airplane.name: Airplane
airplane.description: A powered fixed-wing aircraft used for transporting passengers and cargo.

bus.name: Bus
bus.description: A large motor vehicle designed to carry many passengers on a fixed route.

train.name: Train
train.description: A series of connected carriages pulled by a locomotive along a railway track.
train.safety_warning: Stand behind the yellow line on platforms. Do not cross railway tracks.

truck.name: Truck
truck.description: A large heavy-duty motor vehicle used for transporting goods and materials.
truck.safety_warning: Keep a safe following distance — trucks have large blind spots.

boat.name: Boat
boat.description: A watercraft used for travel, fishing, or recreation on water.
boat.safety_warning: Always wear a life jacket when on open water.

traffic light.name: Traffic Light
traffic light.description: A signalling device at road intersections that controls the flow of traffic using coloured lights.

fire hydrant.name: Fire Hydrant
fire hydrant.description: A connection point on a water supply system used by firefighters to access water.
fire hydrant.safety_warning: Never park in front of a fire hydrant — it blocks emergency access.

stop sign.name: Stop Sign
stop sign.description: A red octagonal road sign that requires drivers to come to a complete stop.

parking meter.name: Parking Meter
parking meter.description: A device used to collect fees for parking a vehicle in a specific space for a limited time.

bench.name: Bench
bench.description: A long seat for multiple people, commonly found in parks, gardens, and public spaces.

bird.name: Bird
bird.description: A warm-blooded vertebrate with feathers, wings, and a beak.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: A small domesticated carnivorous mammal kept as a household pet.
cat.safety_warning: Wash hands after handling. Ensure vaccinations are up to date.

dog.name: Dog
dog.description: A domesticated carnivorous mammal commonly kept as a loyal pet or working animal.
dog.safety_warning: Always keep on a lead in public areas. Ensure vaccinations are up to date.

horse.name: Horse
horse.description: A large hoofed mammal domesticated for riding, racing, and agricultural work.
horse.safety_warning: Approach horses calmly and from the front. Always wear a riding helmet.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: A domesticated ruminant mammal raised for wool, milk, and meat.

cow.name: Cow
cow.description: A large domesticated bovine animal raised for dairy products and beef.

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.description: The world's largest land animal, with a distinctive trunk, large ears, and tusks.

bear.name: Bear
bear.description: A large powerful mammal with thick fur, found in forests and mountains.
bear.safety_warning: Do not approach bears in the wild. Make noise to avoid surprising them.

zebra.name: Zebra
zebra.description: An African equine with distinctive black-and-white striped markings.

giraffe.name: Giraffe
giraffe.description: The tallest living terrestrial animal, native to African savanna.

tie.name: Necktie
tie.description: A long piece of fabric worn around the neck, typically as part of formal attire.

frisbee.name: Frisbee
frisbee.description: A flat circular disc thrown between players as a sport or recreational activity.

skis.name: Skis
skis.description: Long flat runners attached to boots used for gliding over snow.
skis.safety_warning: Always wear a helmet and protective gear when skiing.

snowboard.name: Snowboard
snowboard.description: A single wide board used to slide down snow-covered slopes.
snowboard.safety_warning: Wear a helmet, wrist guards, and knee pads to prevent injury.

sports ball.name: Sports Ball
sports ball.description: A ball used in various sports such as football, basketball, or tennis.

kite.name: Kite
kite.description: A light frame covered with fabric or plastic flown in the wind on a string.
kite.safety_warning: Do not fly near power lines or in stormy weather.

baseball bat.name: Baseball Bat
baseball bat.description: A smooth wooden or metal club used to hit a baseball in the sport of baseball.
baseball bat.safety_warning: Use in designated areas only. Keep away from bystanders when swinging.

baseball glove.name: Baseball Glove
baseball glove.description: A leather glove worn by fielders to catch and field baseballs.

skateboard.name: Skateboard
skateboard.description: A short narrow board with wheels used for skateboarding tricks and transport.
skateboard.safety_warning: Always wear a helmet, knee pads, and wrist guards.

surfboard.name: Surfboard
surfboard.description: A long buoyant board used to ride ocean waves while standing.
surfboard.safety_warning: Never surf alone. Be aware of currents and other surfers.

tennis racket.name: Tennis Racket
tennis racket.description: A handled frame strung with cord, used to strike a tennis ball.
